body: The combined Pi package timeout is shorter than the sum of the two subprocess budgets.
The held-gate assertion does not pin digest-domain, room-ref, and request-digest storage fields.
The Pi successor-model event and exact cardinality should be diagnostic rather than load-bearing.
Removing raw merge-guard terminalization may reject an earlier Codex transcript dialect.

class: correct-but-disproportionate; why-not-material: observed combined Pi components remain below the approved fifteen minute ceiling and no supported proof timed out; promotes-when: a complete combined proof times out or observed latency approaches the package ceiling

class: correct-but-disproportionate; why-not-material: production validation deliberately supports both digest domains and variable retained-room paths while identity plus digest remain exact; promotes-when: a supported same-ID and same-digest binding mutation changes reviewed bytes while passing product validation

class: correct-but-disproportionate; why-not-material: the configured successor model is an AC-3 and AC-4 behavior requirement distinct from optional root-lane diagnostics and is proven by the pinned host; promotes-when: the supported pinned host stops emitting child identity while another durable exact-model proof remains available

class: correct-but-disproportionate; why-not-material: unphased literal merge guard is not dispatch evidence and the accepted oracle requires build wait and durable report phases; promotes-when: a retained supported transcript satisfies every required phase yet the phase-bound grader rejects it
